verdicts.why: Describes plain high regard against admire and revere, matching the gloss; positive charge fits and the example is this sense.
Awe aimed at the hallowed, set above respect, is exactly the gloss's sense and stays inside the word.
Lifting the object into the hallowed and meeting it with awe matches the gloss; positive charge plausible.
Same commendation as sagacity but heavier and less polished is a description of the word's form and feel; the adjective-plus-suffix remark is transparent morphology, not an origin story.
Lofty praise for grasping how things stand in relation tracks the gloss's 'discriminate between relations' and contrasts a neighbour.
Formal register and coolness-under-strain praised as theatrical nerve fits the gloss and stays inside the word.
Says what the word does to the inexplicable (frames it as withheld), matching the mystery gloss; neutral charge is plausible.
Bare practical soundness with nothing qualifying it is the gloss; all three examples are this sense.
Admiring register for an untroubled disposition set above quiet matches the gloss and the positive charge.
Elevated, grave register for a premeditated killing against curt off stays inside the word; negative charge is plausible for the gloss even though the word itself is less condemnatory than murder.
A jumble pulled tight and sounding hostile, harsher than tangle, describes the confused-mass gloss and the word's force; negative fits.
Inward, sustained grief against grieve as an act describes the verb of feeling grief; neutral charge plausible.
Faith declared emphatically, as in 'swear by', against quietly-kept rely fits the confidence gloss; positive plausible.
